title: Missing HTTP Security Headers
description: The registration form and API endpoints are missing several important HTTP security headers that help protect against common web vulnerabilities. The application does not send: X-Frame-Options (clickjacking protection), X-Content-Type-Options (MIME sniffing protection), X-XSS-Protection (legacy XSS filter), Content-Security-Policy (CSP for XSS mitigation), Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS for HTTPS enforcement), X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies (cross-domain attack prevention), or Referrer-Policy (referrer information control). These headers are fundamental security controls recommended by OWASP and security best practices.
impact: 1. **Clickjacking attacks**: Without X-Frame-Options, attackers can embed the registration form in an iframe and trick users into registering without their knowledge. 2. **MIME sniffing attacks**: Without X-Content-Type-Options, browsers might misinterpret content types leading to unintended code execution. 3. **XSS vulnerabilities**: Content-Security-Policy could mitigate XSS impact by restricting script execution and preventing injection attacks. 4. **HTTPS downgrade attacks**: Without HSTS, users might be vulnerable to SSL stripping attacks even if HTTPS is used. 5. **Information leakage**: Missing Referrer-Policy allows referrer information to leak to external sites. 6. **Cross-domain attacks**: Missing X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies allows cross-domain policy exploitation.
evidence:
POC execution confirmed all 7 critical security headers are missing from the HTTP response:

**Verification Output:**
```
[*] Security Headers Analysis:
==================================

[✗] X-Frame-Options: MISSING
[✗] X-Content-Type-Options: MISSING
[✗] X-XSS-Protection: MISSING
[✗] Content-Security-Policy: MISSING
[✗] Strict-Transport-Security: MISSING
[✗] X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: MISSING
[✗] Referrer-Policy: MISSING

==================================
[*] Summary:
    Present: 0
    Missing: 7

[!] VULNERABILITY CONFIRMED: 7 critical security headers are missing!
```

**Actual HTTP Response Headers Received:**
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 16:33:56 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.41 (Ubuntu)
Vary: Accept-Encoding
Content-Length: 4503
Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8
```

The response is missing all recommended security headers. No X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, X-XSS-Protection, CSP, HSTS, X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies, or Referrer-Policy headers are present.
remediation:
Add the following security headers to Apache configuration:

**Option 1: Apache .htaccess or Virtual Host Configuration**

Create or modify .htaccess in the web root with:
```apache
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    Header always set X-Frame-Options "DENY"
    Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
    Header always set X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block"
    Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload"
    Header always set X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies "none"
    Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://code.jquery.com; style-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';"
</IfModule>
```

**Option 2: PHP Header Configuration (application-wide)**

Add to a common initialization file (e.g., config.php or index.php):
```php
// Security Headers
header('X-Frame-Options: DENY');
header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
header('X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block');
header('Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload');
header('X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none');
header('Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
header('Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'self\' https://code.jquery.com; style-src \'self\' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; img-src \'self\' data:; font-src \'self\' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src \'self\'; frame-ancestors \'none\'; base-uri \'self\'; form-action \'self\';');
```

**Header Explanations:**
- **X-Frame-Options: DENY** - Prevents clickjacking by disallowing framing in any context
- **X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff** - Prevents MIME sniffing attacks
- **X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block** - Legacy browser XSS filter (deprecated but still useful)
- **Strict-Transport-Security** - Forces HTTPS for 1 year and applies to subdomains
- **X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none** - Prevents cross-domain policy exploitation
- **Referrer-Policy** - Controls referrer information leakage
- **Content-Security-Policy** - Prevents inline script execution and restricts resource loading

**Verification:**
After implementing, verify headers are present using:
```bash
curl -i http://localhost:8080/register.php | grep -i "X-Frame-Options\|X-Content-Type-Options\|Content-Security-Policy"
```
